articles.title_en: The Impact of Trade Liberalization in the Presence of Political Distortions †
articles.title_cn: 政治扭曲存在下的贸易自由化影响†
articles.abstract_en: Political distortions are prevalent in many developing countries, implying substantial productivity losses. This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on political distortions in India. First, using variation in political turnover, we identify that politicians distort resources in favor of politically connected firms. Second, we show that reduced tariffs on input goods significantly decrease the distortionary effect of political connections, as trade reduces firms' dependence on politicians for sourcing inputs. The results suggest a new margin for gains from trade through reduced politically driven misallocation, implying that trade can address a widespread source of productivity losses. (JEL D22, D72, F13, F14, O14, O19, O24)
articles.abstract_cn: 政治扭曲在许多发展中国家普遍存在，导致巨大的生产率损失。本文研究了贸易自由化对印度政治扭曲的影响。首先，利用政治更替的变化，我们识别出政治家将资源偏向于有政治关联的企业。其次，我们表明，投入品关税的降低显著减少了政治关联的扭曲效应，因为贸易降低了企业从政治家获取投入品的依赖。结果表明，通过减少政治驱动的资源错配，贸易收益存在新的边际，意味着贸易可以解决一个广泛存在的生产率损失来源。(JEL D22, D72, F13, F14, O14, O19, O24)

articles.title_en: Tax Incentives for Migrants with Mid-level Earnings: Evidence from the Netherlands †
articles.title_cn: 中等收入移民的税收激励：来自荷兰的证据†
articles.abstract_en: We examine how income taxes affect international mobility and wages. We study a Dutch preferential tax scheme for migrants, which introduced an income threshold for eligibility in 2012. The threshold is low relative to similar schemes in other countries, thereby offering eligibility to migrants with mid-level earnings. We find migration more than doubles closely above the income threshold, while migration below the threshold remains unchanged. These effects appear to be driven by additional migration, while wage bargaining responses are limited. We estimate a migration elasticity ranging from 1.6 to 2.7, somewhat higher than most studies on high-income migrants have found. (JEL H24, H31, J15, J31, J82)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了所得税如何影响国际流动性和工资。我们考察了荷兰一项针对移民的优惠税收计划，该计划于2012年引入了资格收入门槛。该门槛相对于其他国家的类似计划较低，从而使中等收入的移民有资格享受该计划。我们发现，收入略高于门槛的移民数量增加了一倍以上，而低于门槛的移民数量保持不变。这些效应似乎是由额外的移民驱动的，而工资谈判的回应有限。我们估计的移民弹性范围为1.6至2.7，略高于大多数关于高收入移民的研究结果。(JEL H24, H31, J15, J31, J82)

articles.title_en: Can Development Programs Counter Insurgencies? Evidence from a Field Experiment in Afghanistan †
articles.title_cn: 发展项目能否遏制叛乱？来自阿富汗实地实验的证据†
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a randomized controlled trial conducted between 2007 and 2011 to identify the effect of Afghanistan's largest local governance and development program on the strength of the insurgency. We find that the program reduced violence, improved economic outcomes, and increased government support in interior regions of the country, but increased violence in villages close to the Pakistani border, where foreign insurgents were more numerous. The results suggest that development programs can be effective in suppressing locally driven insurgencies, but may be counterproductive where insurgents are not reliant on the local population for support. (JEL C93, D74, F35, O15, O17, O18)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用在2007年至2011年间进行的一项随机对照试验，来识别阿富汗最大的地方治理与发展项目对叛乱强度的影响。我们发现，该项目在该国内陆地区减少了暴力、改善了经济成果并增加了政府支持，但在靠近巴基斯坦边境的村庄，由于外国叛乱分子更为众多，暴力反而增加。结果表明，发展项目在抑制地方驱动的叛乱方面可能有效，但在叛乱分子不依赖当地人口支持的情况下可能适得其反。(JEL C93, D74, F35, O15, O17, O18)

articles.title_en: Not Playing Favorites: Parents and the Value of Equal Opportunity †
articles.title_cn: 不偏不倚：父母与机会均等的价值†
articles.abstract_en: We conduct two experiments to identify the value parents place on equality of opportunity when investing in children. The experiments exogenously vary short-run returns to educational investments to identify the weight placed on equalizing “opportunity” (child-level investment) relative to maximizing “returns” (total household earnings) or to equalizing “outcomes” (child-level expected earnings). While parents in both experiments place some weight on maximizing returns, they also display a strong preference for equalizing opportunities and are willing to forgo 15–45 percent of their earnings to do so. Parents in higher-income countries also care about equalizing outcomes, while parents in lower-income countries do not. (JEL D63, J12, J13, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了两项实验，以识别父母在投资子女时对机会均等所赋予的价值。实验外生地变化教育投资的短期回报，以识别在“机会”均等（子女层面的投资）与“回报”最大化（家庭总收入）或“结果”均等（子女层面的预期收入）之间所赋予的权重。尽管两项实验中的父母都赋予回报最大化一定的权重，但他们也表现出对机会均等的强烈偏好，并愿意为此放弃其收入的15-45%。高收入国家的父母也关心结果均等，而低收入国家的父母则不然。(JEL D63, J12, J13, O15)

articles.title_en: Food Transfers and Child Nutrition: Evidence from India's Public Distribution System †
articles.title_cn: 粮食转移和儿童营养：来自印度公共分配系统的证据 †
articles.abstract_en: India's National Food Security Act of 2013 (NFSA) led to one of the biggest expansions in food transfers in history, affecting over 500 million people. We use plausibly exogenous variation created by the NFSA to estimate the effect of food transfers on child nutrition. Using individual panel data across eight states in India over five years, we find that increased transfers significantly reduced stunting. The food transfers increased wage incomes and improved dietary diversity. Our results suggest that, in the states we study, the NFSA prevented approximately 1.8 million children from being stunted (JEL I12, I18, I38, J13, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 印度 2013 (NFSA) 国家粮食安全法案导致了历史上最大的粮食转移扩张之一，影响了超过 500 万人。我们使用 NFSA 产生的看似合理的外生变异来估计食品转移对儿童营养的影响。使用印度八个邦五年来的单独面板数据，我们发现转移的增加显着减少了发育迟缓。粮食转移增加了工资收入并改善了饮食多样性。我们的结果表明，在我们研究的州中，NFSA 防止了大约 1.8 万名儿童发育迟缓（JEL I12、I18、I38、J13、O12）

articles.title_en: Skill Depreciation during Unemployment: Evidence from Panel Data †
articles.title_cn: 失业期间的技能折旧：来自面板数据的证据†
articles.abstract_en: We examine the depreciation of skills among unemployed German workers using a panel of skill measures linked to administrative data. Both the reemployment hazard and reemployment earnings steadily decline with unemployment duration. Indicators of depression and loneliness also rise substantially. However, we find no decline in a wide range of cognitive and noncognitive skills while workers remain unemployed. We find the same pattern in a panel of American workers. The results imply that skill depreciation in general human capital is unlikely to be a major explanation for observed duration dependence in reemployment outcomes. (JEL E24, E32, J22, J24, J31, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用与行政数据关联的技能度量面板，考察了德国失业工人技能折旧的情况。再就业风险和再就业收入均随失业持续时间稳步下降。抑郁和孤独感的指标也显著上升。然而，我们发现工人在失业期间，广泛的认知和非认知技能并未下降。在美国工人的面板数据中，我们观察到相同的模式。结果表明，一般人力资本的技能折旧不太可能是观察到的再就业结果持续时间依赖性的主要解释。(JEL E24, E32, J22, J24, J31, J64)

articles.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of worker voice on productivity, job quality, and separations. We study the 1991 introduction of a right to worker representation on boards or advisory councils in Finnish firms with at least 150 employees, designed to facilitate workforce-management communication. Consistent with information-sharing theories, our difference-in-differences design reveals that worker voice raised labor productivity. In contrast to exit-voice theory, we find no effects on voluntary job separations. However, treated firms reduce involuntary separations (during our recessionary sample period). A 2008 introduction of shop-floor representation, another worker voice institution preexisting in our main firm sample, had more limited effects. (JEL E32, J24, J53, J63, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了员工发言权对生产率、工作质量和离职的影响。我们研究了1991年芬兰引入的一项权利，即员工在拥有至少150名员工的公司中拥有董事会或咨询委员会的代表权，该权利旨在促进劳动力与管理层之间的沟通。与信息共享理论一致，我们的双重差分设计显示，员工发言权提高了劳动生产率。与退出-发言权理论相反，我们发现对自愿离职没有影响。然而，在处理组公司中，非自愿离职减少了（在我们的衰退样本期间）。2008年引入的车间代表制，即我们主要公司样本中已存在的另一种员工发言权制度，其影响较为有限。（JEL E32, J24, J53, J63, M54）

articles.title_en: Preferences, Selection, and the Structure of Teacher Pay
articles.title_cn: 偏好、选择与教师薪酬结构
articles.abstract_en: I examine teacher preferences using a discrete-choice experiment linked to data on teacher effectiveness. I estimate willingness to pay for a rich set of compensation elements and working conditions. Highly effective teachers usually have the same preferences as their peers, but they have stronger preferences for performance pay. I use the preference estimates to investigate the optimal compensation structure for three key objectives: maximizing teacher utility, maximizing teacher retention, and maximizing student achievement. Under each objective, schools underutilize salary and performance pay while overutilizing retirement benefits. Restructuring compensation can significantly improve both teacher welfare and student achievement. (JEL H75, I21, J31, J32, J45, J81)
articles.abstract_cn: 我通过一个与教师效能数据相关联的离散选择实验来考察教师偏好。我估算了教师对一系列丰富薪酬要素和工作条件的支付意愿。高效教师通常与同行具有相同的偏好，但他们更偏好绩效工资。我利用偏好估计来研究三个关键目标下的最优薪酬结构：最大化教师效用、最大化教师保留率以及最大化学生成就。在每个目标下，学校都未充分利用工资和绩效工资，而过度利用退休福利。重构薪酬可以显著提高教师福利和学生成就。（JEL H75, I21, J31, J32, J45, J81）

articles.title_en: Background Matters, but Not Whether Parents Are Immigrants: Outcomes of Children Born in Denmark
articles.title_cn: 背景重要，但父母是否为移民并不重要：丹麦出生儿童的结果
articles.abstract_en: In Europe, the children of migrants often have worse economic outcomes than those with local-born parents. This paper shows that children born in Denmark with immigrant parents (first-generation locals) have lower earnings, higher unemployment, less education, more welfare transfers, and more criminal convictions than children with local-born parents. However, when we condition on parental socioeconomic characteristics, first-generation locals generally perform as well or slightly better than the children of locals. While children of immigrants are more likely to come from deprived backgrounds, they do not experience substantially different outcomes conditional on parental background. (JEL I38, J13, J15, J31, J82)
articles.abstract_cn: 在欧洲，移民子女的经济结果往往比本地出生父母的子女更差。本文表明，在丹麦出生且父母为移民的儿童（第一代本地人）与本地出生父母的子女相比，收入更低、失业率更高、教育程度更低、福利转移更多，且犯罪定罪更多。然而，当我们以父母的社会经济特征为条件时，第一代本地人的表现通常与本地人的子女相当或略好。虽然移民子女更可能来自贫困背景，但在以父母背景为条件的情况下，他们的结果并没有显著差异。(JEL I38, J13, J15, J31, J82)

articles.title_en: Salary History and Employer Demand: Evidence from a Two-Sided Audit
articles.title_cn: 薪资披露与雇主需求：来自双边审计的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how salary disclosures affect employer demand using a field experiment featuring hundreds of recruiters evaluating over 2,000 job applications. We randomize the presence of salary questions and the candidates' disclosures for male and female applicants. Our findings suggest that extra dollars disclosed yield higher salary offers, willingness to pay, and perceptions of outside options by recruiters (all similarly for men and women). Recruiters make negative inferences about the quality and bargaining positions of nondisclosing candidates, though they penalize silent women less. (JEL C93, D82, J22, J23, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项涉及数百名招聘人员评估超过2,000份求职申请的实地实验，研究薪资披露如何影响雇主需求。我们随机化薪资问题的存在以及男性和女性申请人的披露情况。我们的研究结果表明，披露的额外美元带来更高的薪资报价、支付意愿以及招聘人员对外部选项的感知（男女均类似）。招聘人员对不披露的候选人的质量和谈判地位做出负面推断，尽管他们对沉默的女性惩罚较少。（JEL C93, D82, J22, J23, J31）

articles.title_en: Information Systems, Service Delivery, and Corruption: Evidence From the Bangladesh Civil Service
articles.title_cn: 信息系统、服务提供与腐败：来自孟加拉国公务员体系的证据
articles.abstract_en: Slow public service delivery and corruption are common problems in low- and middle-income countries. Can better management information systems improve delivery speed? Does improving the delivery speed reduce corruption? In a large-scale experiment with the Bangladesh Civil Service, I send monthly scorecards measuring delays in service delivery to government officials and their supervisors. The scorecards increase on-time service delivery by 11 percent but do not reduce bribes. Instead, the scorecards increase bribes for high-performing bureaucrats. A model where bureaucrats' reputational concerns constrain bribes can explain the results. When positive performance feedback improves bureaucrats' reputations, the constraint is relaxed, and bribes increase. (JEL D73, D83, H83, O17)
articles.abstract_cn: 公共服务提供缓慢和腐败是中低收入国家常见的问题。更好的管理信息系统能否提高服务提供速度？提高服务提供速度是否会减少腐败？在与孟加拉国公务员体系进行的大规模实验中，我每月向政府官员及其上级发送衡量服务提供延迟的记分卡。记分卡将按时服务提供率提高了11%，但并未减少贿赂。相反，记分卡增加了高绩效官僚的贿赂。一个将官僚声誉关切视为贿赂约束的模型可以解释这些结果。当正面绩效反馈改善官僚声誉时，约束放松，贿赂增加。(JEL D73, D83, H83, O17)
